scheme.title: Access
scheme.description: Access condition of a resource or of one of its data entries. Always explicit in MOSAIC: it is never assumed to be public. Same values as the Climate Data Hub (DCAT / EU access rights).

concepts.label: Public
concepts.description: Anyone can obtain the data without asking.

concepts.label: Restricted
concepts.description: The record is public, but the data needs a request, an account or an agreement.

concepts.label: Non-public
concepts.description: Catalogued for the network; the data is not available outside the team that holds it (v0.1: internal).
